tle_tvted_model.BTLEd: Qualification/degree path; not itself a unique LEPT specialization.
tle_tvted_model.BTVTEd: Qualification/degree path for the distinct TVTEd specialization.
tle_tvted_model.TLE: Current PRC path in which BTLEd candidates select exactly one of AFA, HE, ICT, or IA.
tle_tvted_model.TVTEd: Distinct PRC specialization bounded to introductory courses and common competencies.
tle_tvted_model.AFA: Teacher-relevant agriculture/fishery foundation, not a generic agriculture board.
tle_tvted_model.HE: Teacher-relevant household, food, textile, resource, and livelihood foundation, not cooking alone.
tle_tvted_model.ICT: Teacher-relevant digital systems, productivity, networks, logic, media, and citizenship, not software engineering.
tle_tvted_model.IA: Teacher-relevant materials, drawing, tools, electricity, construction, mechanics, and fabrication with safety limits.
tle_tvted_model.tesda_role: Competency and instructional reference; TESDA qualification/certification scope is not equated with LEPT scope.

quantitative_semantics.numeric_context_definition: Any item whose stem or answer reasoning supplies quantitative data; this is the umbrella category.

quantitative_semantics.relationship: CALCULATION_REQUIRED ⊆ NUMERICAL_CONTEXT; conceptual quantitative items are numerical context without required arithmetic.
